ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $C$ is on line $AB$, and $CD$ bisects $\angle ACE$. If $\angle 1 = 63^\circ$, then what is the measure of $\angle BCE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $CD$ bisects $\angle ACE$, and $\angle 1=63^\circ$,

it follows that $\angle ACE=2\angle 1=126^\circ$,

Since $\angle ACE+\angle BCE=180^\circ$,

it follows that $\angle BCE=180^\circ−126^\circ=\boxed{54^\circ}$.
